children: Joby Aviation filed a prospectus supplement for the resale of 2,419,801 common shares issued tied to EBITDA milestones from the Strata Critical Medical passenger segment acquisition.
Filed a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement covering resale of 2,419,801 common shares.
Shares were issued to a selling stockholder for achievement of EBITDA milestones in the 12 months after closing of the Strata passenger segment acquisition.
Prospectus supplement is part of Registration Statement on Form S-3 (No. 333-282809) originally filed Oct 24, 2024.
Legal opinion from Latham & Watkins LLP on validity of issuance filed as Exhibit 5.1 and incorporated by reference.
